about-me.title: About me:
about-me.description: Systems Development Technician with an interest in front-end development, currently studying Information Technology Management
about-me.content: My name is Julia Paiva, I am 19 years old and I am from São Paulo metropolitan area. I started my studies in technology at the age of 16 through a technical course in Systems Development and continued my education by choosing to study Information Technology Management. Although I have a solid foundation and practical experience in the analytical field, my profile is highly communicative and, above all, creative. That is why I am currently studying Marketing, aiming to complement my technical knowledge with a more strategic perspective focused on communication.

1.title: Technical Course - Systems Development
1.description: Training focused on programming logic, systems development, and technology fundamentals aimed at the job market.

2.title: Degree - Information Technology Management
2.description: Training focused on technology resource management, information systems, and IT projects within organizations.

3.title: Cybersecurity Apprentice
3.description: Worked as an apprentice in the cybersecurity field, focusing on privacy and data protection, vulnerability analysis, and information security best practices.

1.title: Offensive Security
1.description: Worked on the migration and implementation of the Privacy Tools platform, supporting companies such as Banco do Nordeste, Sura, and Yamaha in risk management, privacy activities, and LGPD compliance.

2.title: Governance and Privacy
2.description: Participated in the planning, execution, and analysis of internal phishing campaigns, contributing to user awareness and strengthening the security culture. Supported Red Team activities, assisting in the identification of external vulnerabilities, risk analysis, and security testing at Sompo Seguros.

4.title: Junior Frontend Developer
4.description: Professional experience developing modern, responsive web interfaces focused on user experience in the retail market.

1.title: User Experience Design
1.description: Focused on user experience to build digital interfaces through journey analysis, flow organization, and layout structuring.

2.title: Web Development
2.description: Development of web applications and interfaces using modern technologies, focusing on performance, responsiveness, usability, and programming best practices, ensuring functional and efficient solutions.
